run_crows_pairs_preprocessing: run the CrowsPairs dataset preprocessing to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_crowspairs_classification_dataset: create a CrowsPairs classification dataset instance with sentence 1 and sentence 2 labels
load_crows_pairs_hf_dataset: load the crows_pairs HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of sentence pairs with randomized ordering and labels
split_train_test_lines: split the CrowsPairs dataset into 80 percent train and 20 percent test lines
